subject: Coord: APAC demo — daylight crossover & calendar clarification for Kaito Logistics
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@kaitologistics.jp>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@kaitologistics.com.au>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 06:30:00 -0700
Subject: Kaito — demo times (Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney)

Hi Kenji & Priya,

Thanks for the interest — excited to show Redwood Inference to the Kaito platform team. To avoid the usual timezone trap, proposing three concrete slots that align to local APAC hours. All times below are listed with local labels (JST / SGT / AEST) so there is no conversion guesswork:

Option A: 2027-05-10 10:00 JST / 09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST
Option B: 2027-05-10 15:00 JST / 14:00 SGT / 16:00 AEST
Option C: 2027-05-11 09:00 JST / 08:00 SGT / 10:00 AEST (falls into next business day in Sydney)

Quick notes:
- We intentionally listed all three local labels so you can pick by what works in Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney.
- In May Sydney is on standard time (AEST, UTC+10) — no daylight savings active in that window.

If you confirm which option works, I will send an ICS and a short demo agenda. If none of these fit, tell me a 60–90 minute window and we will adapt.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 98KB)

From: Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@kaitologistics.jp>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@kaitologistics.com.au>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:05:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Kaito — demo times (Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney)

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear options. Quick question: Option C says 09:00 JST on the 11th but 10:00 AEST; that looks like "next day" in Sydney relative to Tokyo? We want to avoid any confusion for our APAC hubs — can you confirm whether Option C is intended to be a next-business-day slot for Sydney or if I misread the mapping?

Also, Priya is out tomorrow morning for a client on-site — she asked if there is a late-afternoon Tokyo time that would still be within Singapore hours.

Best,
Kenji
Head of Platform
Kaito Logistics

From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@kaitologistics.com.au>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@kaitologistics.jp>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 12:20:00 +1000
Subject: Re: Kaito — demo times (Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney)

Michael — quick note on DST: Sydney moved back to standard time in early April so May is AEST (UTC+10). That means when Kenji says May 11 09:00 JST = May 11 10:00 AEST, both are same calendar day (not next day). The only cross-day confusion happens if sessions are near midnight.

If you can do a later Tokyo option (e.g., 17:30 JST / 16:30 SGT / 18:30 AEST) that would be great for our east-coast team.

Regards,
Priya
VP, Global Ops
Kaito Logistics

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@kaitologistics.jp>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@kaitologistics.com.au>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 14:00:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Kaito — demo times (Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney)

Thanks for the flag, Kenji — quick convert table to remove ambiguity:
- 2027-05-10 10:00 JST = 2027-05-10 09:00 SGT = 2027-05-10 11:00 AEST
- 2027-05-10 15:00 JST = 2027-05-10 14:00 SGT = 2027-05-10 16:00 AEST
- 2027-05-11 09:00 JST = 2027-05-11 08:00 SGT = 2027-05-11 10:00 AEST (same calendar day across APAC; not a "rollover" case)

A few practical tips so this doesn't repeat in the invite: we will set the calendar event in the invite to show times in each participant's calendar client (ICS contains TZ info), and we'll add the ISO UTC time in the body too.

Michael: Kenji / Priya prefer a later Tokyo slot — you can propose 2027-05-10 17:30 JST (16:30 SGT / 18:30 AEST) as a new Option D if that works on your side.

Thanks,
Ava
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@kaitologistics.jp>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@kaitologistics.com.au>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 14:15:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Kaito — demo times (Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney)

Perfect — thanks Ava and Priya.

Option D: 2027-05-10 17:30 JST / 16:30 SGT / 18:30 AEST — booking now. I attached a 30-minute ICS (redwood-demo.ics) and a short agenda (demo-agenda.pdf). The ICS contains timezone tags so calendar apps will render local times (please double-check the timezone in your client before accepting).

If anyone needs the 60-min slot instead, reply-all and I will expand.

Regards,
Michael
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo.ics (calendar invite), demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

-Kenji
